plan.major: University Studies — Race, Gender, Ethnicity Concentration
plan.notes:
Per the 2026-2027 Texas A&M University undergraduate catalog: University Studies — Race, Gender, Ethnicity Concentration (BA). Prerequisites are not listed in the catalog's plan of study grid; consult course descriptions.
Catalog footnotes:
[grid1 fn1] Select from AFST 201 , GLST 201 , JWST 201/RELS 201 , LMAS 201 , WGST 200 , or any course approved by the Department of Global Languages and Cultures.
[grid1 fn2] Students must complete Intermediate level foreign language coursework to complete degree requirements, however students will be required to complete or successfully place out of beginning level language courses prior to intermediate course enrollment. Students can apply the first eight hours (beginning 1 and 2) of foreign language courses as eight hours of general electives in their degree program.
[grid1 fn3] Select from ANTH 404/WGST 404 , ANTH 427 ; COMM 335 , COMM 407/WGST 407 , COMM 420/WGST 420 ; POLS 304 , POLS 317 , POLS 320 , POLS 367/WGST 367 , POLS 462/WGST 462 ; PBSI 300/WGST 300 ; SOCI 207/WGST 207 , SOCI 317/AFST 317 , SOCI 323/AFST 323 , SOCI 403 , SOCI 410/WGST 410 , SOCI 421/WGST 421 .
